prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Companion Controls", "Practice hiding, summoning, and moving your desktop pet in this quick guided flow before starting.", "Practice Desktop Docking & Dragging", "Start Quick Practice"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Sprite & Physics", "Your pet's desktop animation rig and sound files are currently loading into memory."]
2: ["Choose Desktop Docking Position", "Select where your companion lives on screen and configure tray icon shortcuts.", "Confirm Companion Setup"]
3: ["Calibrate Custom Pet Appearance", "Adjust sprite scaling and visual alignment before sending your pet to generation.", "Calibrate & Proceed"]
4: ["Try Summoning & Hiding Your Pet", "Click the system tray icon or press the shortcut key to toggle pet visibility.", "Test Tray Toggle"]
5: ["Finalizing Companion Asset Pipeline", "Estimated time remaining until pet lands on desktop:"]
6: ["Select Your Ideal Companion Journey", "Choose between casual desktop sidekick or story-driven adventure mode."]
7: ["Sign In to Restore Existing Companions", "Your saved pets and customizations will sync automatically upon authentication.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled", "Existing pets found will be preserved."]
8: ["Quick Reference & Shortcut Guide", "Here is everything you need to know to interact with your pet on the desktop.", "Right-click pet for interaction menu", "Double-click tray icon to hide/show", "Launch Companion to Desktop"]
9: ["Building Pet Desktop Assets", "Tracking generation steps in real time:", "Step 1: Generating 3D Model Mesh", "Step 2: Rendering Desktop Animations"]
